name: Standard Ebooks Public Domain Literature Collection
license: Public Domain in US / CC0 1.0 Universal for typography & editorial
description: Carefully formatted, proofread, and typographically rich public domain literature and essays.
attribution_requirements: Preserve attribution to Standard Ebooks and original authors in metadata.
privacy_considerations: Historical literary public domain texts; zero contemporary PII.
checksum_procedure: sha256sum of raw git repository release archives
reviewer_notes: Exceptional editorial quality, proofread against first editions, rich punctuation (smart quotes, em-dashes). Prime candidate for long-form English exposure.
unresolved_questions: None for US jurisdiction; verify UK/EU life+70 expiration on 1920s authors prior to non-US deployment.
work_level_scope: Complete Standard Ebooks release catalog; excludes non-standard external mirrors.
jurisdiction_limitations: US Public Domain (published pre-1929). Non-US distributions subject to local life+70 rules.
access_api_terms: Standard Ebooks public bulk git repositories and feed downloads; comply with fair-use rate limits.
mixed_license_risks: Cover artwork may carry separate licenses; XHTML parser must discard cover images and retain only literary prose.
reviewer_identity: VEDA Data Governance Audit Committee (Lead Auditor: Antigravity)
re_review_triggers: 180-day periodic audit cycle, upstream license alteration, or major release update.

name: Project Gutenberg Public Domain Corpus
license: Public Domain in the United States
description: Extensive archive of public domain books published before 1929.
attribution_requirements: Gutenberg trademark must be removed from text before distribution unless under trademark license.
redistribution_requirements: Plain text of public domain books freely redistributable without PG header/footer.
modification_conditions: Public domain text freely modifiable; trademark notice must be detached.
privacy_considerations: Public domain texts published before 1929; zero contemporary PII.
checksum_procedure: sha256sum of individual UTF-8 text downloads from aleph.gutenberg.org
reviewer_notes: Extensive vocabulary coverage. Strict requirement: PG header and footer boilerplate MUST be stripped using START/END markers to avoid massive memorization of license disclaimers.
unresolved_questions: Automated header/footer strip verification heuristics must be benchmarked on sample.
work_level_scope: Pre-1929 US public domain titles only. Copyrighted-with-permission items (e.g. #13000 series) strictly excluded.
jurisdiction_limitations: Public domain in the United States. Titles published 1923-1928 verified pre-1929 under US law.
access_api_terms: Mirror via official rsync or aleph.gutenberg.org off-peak; automated scraping of www.gutenberg.org prohibited by robots.txt.
mixed_license_risks: Modern editorial forewords or footnotes in newer editions; must verify text against first edition scans.
reviewer_identity: VEDA Data Governance Audit Committee (Lead Auditor: Antigravity)
re_review_triggers: 180-day periodic audit cycle, catalog metadata updates, or copyright law amendments.

name: OpenStax Peer-Reviewed College Textbooks
description: Peer-reviewed, openly licensed introductory and advanced college textbooks.
attribution_requirements: Include attribution to OpenStax in dataset documentation.
redistribution_requirements: Unrestricted sharing with attribution under CC-BY 4.0.
modification_conditions: Adaptations permitted with appropriate attribution and notice of changes.
privacy_considerations: Educational textbooks; standard author bio attributions; zero sensitive private data.
checksum_procedure: sha256sum of official OpenStax CNX archive tarballs
reviewer_notes: High pedagogical value for explanatory reasoning, STEM terminology, structured chapter progression. CC-BY attribution preserved in manifest.
unresolved_questions: Filter out repetitive problem-set solution keys or keep as question-answer pairs?
work_level_scope: Official published OpenStax college textbooks in HTML/CNX format.
jurisdiction_limitations: Global applicability under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
access_api_terms: Direct download of bulk archive tarballs from OpenStax repository.
mixed_license_risks: Certain third-party photographs or illustration figures may have All Rights Reserved permissions; parser must extract running text prose only.
reviewer_identity: VEDA Data Governance Audit Committee (Lead Auditor: Antigravity)
re_review_triggers: 180-day periodic audit cycle, textbook new edition releases.

name: Python Official Documentation & Library Reference
license: Python Software Foundation License Version 2 / Zero-Clause BSD
description: Authoritative technical documentation, tutorials, and standard library reference for Python.
attribution_requirements: Notice of PSFL preserved in documentation.
redistribution_requirements: Permissive redistribution allowed under PSFL v2.

name: English Wikinews Journalistic Archive
description: Collaborative journalistic reporting of current affairs and world events.
modification_conditions: Modifications permitted with attribution under CC-BY 2.5.
privacy_considerations: Public news events; public figures; low risk of private personal data.
reviewer_notes: Crucial difference from Wikipedia: Wikinews is CC-BY 2.5, NOT CC-BY-SA! Attribution-only allows clean pretraining use without ShareAlike derivative debates. Excellent contemporary journalistic prose.
unresolved_questions: Date filter cutoff to avoid short breaking news wire snippets (< 100 words).
work_level_scope: Complete main namespace published news articles in enwikinews dump.
jurisdiction_limitations: Global applicability under Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Generic.
access_api_terms: Official Wikimedia dump mirrors (dumps.wikimedia.org); follow robots.txt.
mixed_license_risks: Embedded wire photos (Associated Press, Reuters) are fair-use or copyrighted; XML parser extracts article text only, discarding media.
reviewer_identity: VEDA Data Governance Audit Committee (Lead Auditor: Antigravity)
re_review_triggers: 180-day periodic audit cycle, monthly Wikimedia dump update.

name: PLOS Peer-Reviewed Open Access Scientific Corpus
description: Peer-reviewed scientific research articles across biology, medicine, and computational science.
attribution_requirements: Credit original authors and PLOS publication.
redistribution_requirements: Unrestricted sharing with attribution under CC-BY 4.0.
modification_conditions: Adaptations permitted with attribution and notice of modifications.
privacy_considerations: Scholarly publications; researcher names and affiliations public; medical studies anonymized.
checksum_procedure: sha256sum of monthly PLOS all-journals bulk dataset dumps
reviewer_notes: Exemplary scientific prose, rigorous methodology descriptions, Greek symbol usage, academic discourse. PLOS explicitly permits and supports Text and Data Mining (TDM).
unresolved_questions: XML extraction pipeline needed to strip tabular data and raw author metadata blocks.
work_level_scope: Peer-reviewed research articles across all PLOS journal publications (PLOS ONE, Biology, Medicine, Computational Biology, Genetics, Pathogens, Neglected Tropical Diseases).
jurisdiction_limitations: Global applicability under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
access_api_terms: Official PLOS bulk API or FTP dump access explicitly intended for text and data mining.
mixed_license_risks: Third-party reprinted scientific diagrams or clinical photographs; JATS-XML extraction isolates text body tags, stripping figures and supplementals.
reviewer_identity: VEDA Data Governance Audit Committee (Lead Auditor: Antigravity)
re_review_triggers: 180-day periodic audit cycle, PLOS quarterly bulk release updates.

name: Simple English Wikipedia Dump
license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC-BY-SA 4.0) and GFDL
description: Encyclopedic articles written in simple, clear English for foundation learning.
attribution_requirements: Attribution to Simple Wikipedia contributors and link to original article.
redistribution_requirements: Derivative adaptations must be licensed under CC-BY-SA 4.0.
privacy_considerations: Living persons biographies require living person neutrality; public contributors.
reviewer_notes: Exceptional linguistic simplicity and conceptual breadth. Gated under REQUIRES_REVIEW because CC-BY-SA requires derivative adaptations to be released under CC-BY-SA. Whether model weights constitute an adaptation is an active legal debate.
unresolved_questions: Formal legal review of CC-BY-SA downstream weight licensing requirements.
access_api_terms: Wikimedia official dumps; comply with user-agent policy.
mixed_license_risks: CC-BY-SA text mixed with GFDL legacy text and fair-use image references.
reviewer_identity: VEDA Data Governance Audit Committee (Lead Auditor: Antigravity)
re_review_triggers: Legal precedent clarification on CC-BY-SA and neural weights.

name: English Wikipedia Full Article Dump
description: Complete English Wikipedia article collection covering broad general knowledge.
privacy_considerations: BLP (Biographies of Living Persons) privacy and defamation risks; vandalism.
reviewer_notes: Massive scale and domain breadth. Gated under REQUIRES_REVIEW due to CC-BY-SA ShareAlike conditions and complex wikitext template filtering requirements.
unresolved_questions: Legal determination of CC-BY-SA compatibility + compute budget to process 22 GB compressed bz2.
mixed_license_risks: Wikitext infobox templates, fair use excerpts, user vandalism.
reviewer_identity: VEDA Data Governance Audit Committee (Lead Auditor: Antigravity)
re_review_triggers: Legal opinion on ShareAlike implications for trained models.
